notes: Pure public-API Annex C.8 witnesses use three schema-valid, adapter-owned FOM modules to compare equivalent and conflicting Advisories Use Known Class settings. The native private preflight case passed 1/1, and the separate installed-package portable CTest/direct gate passed 8/8 each across both callback models. Java parity compiles against the API-only JAR but provider runtime is unverified. The portable cases assert only public Create, joined getAdvisoriesUseKnownClassSwitch, Resign, and Destroy outcomes. Private warnings, omitted advisory settings, callback delivery policy, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
